failure.unsupported: This browser can't read the device's compass.
failure.insecure: The compass only works when the page is opened over HTTPS.
failure.denied: You haven't allowed access to the orientation sensor. Allow it in your browser settings and try again.
failure.noSignal: No compass signal — computers and many browsers don't have this sensor.

heading.outside: I'm standing outside, looking at the house
heading.magnetWarning: Stay away from steel columns, cars, roller doors, magnets and electrical equipment — they throw off the compass.

steps.stand: Stand at the main door with your back to the house, looking straight out.
steps.hold: Hold the phone flat (parallel to the ground), with its top pointing where you're looking.
steps.wait: Hold still for a few seconds until the reading settles, then press “Lock reading”.

device.unstable: The reading is jumping a lot. Hold still, move the phone in a figure 8 a few times so it recalibrates, then measure again.

live.title: House orientation compass
live.intro: Stand at the main door with your back to the house, hold the phone flat with its top pointing straight out.
live.dialAria: Compass dial, north at the top
live.empty: Press “Start measuring” or enter a bearing to read the house orientation.
live.failureManual: {{failure}} You can enter a bearing measured with another compass.
live.unstable: The reading is jumping too much to lock. Hold still and move the phone in a figure 8 a few times so it recalibrates.
live.centered: Right at the center of the {{mountain}} mountain.
live.voidWarning: {{kind}} — the direction is right on the boundary of {{mountain}} / {{toward}}. {{note}}

manual.label: Bearing of {{target}}
manual.hint: Measured clockwise from north: east 90°, south 180°, west 270°.

method.title: How do you want to get the direction?
method.label: Method
method.drawingNote: No sensor needed: you just need a drawing with a north symbol. Place the north arrow on the image, then place the axis of the item to measure.

canvas.traceGrip: Point {{index}} of the trace — tap to select the trace, drag or use the arrow keys to adjust
canvas.closeAria: Close the shape at the first point
canvas.northHead: North arrow head — drag to rotate it to the drawing's north symbol
canvas.northTail: North arrow tail — drag to move
canvas.compassCenter: Compass center — drag to move the compass
canvas.compassEdge: Compass edge — drag to enlarge / shrink

traceHints.line: Tap two points to draw a wall segment. Tap the end of a drawn segment to label it as frontage / main door.
traceHints.polygon: Tap each corner in turn, then tap the first point (hollow circle) again to close the shape.
traceHints.rect: Tap two opposite corners to draw a rectangle.

hints.north: Tap the north symbol on the drawing to place the north arrow, then drag the arrowhead to match the symbol's direction.
hints.door: Tap the main door to add a door axis (optional). Drag the arrowhead to point outward.
hints.drawing: Tap the spot to measure to place the {{target}} axis. Drag the arrowhead to point OUTWARD — the view from inside looking out.
hints.overlay: To put the compass on the image: tap the spot to measure and drag the arrowhead outward along the {{target}} direction.

solar.title: Sunlight & sun path

locationFailure.denied: You haven't allowed location access. Enter the latitude and longitude manually.
locationFailure.unavailable: The device couldn't get your location. Enter the latitude and longitude manually.

daySide.AFTERNOON: gets afternoon sun (harsh, heats the house)
daySide.BOTH: gets both morning and afternoon sun
daySide.NONE: gets little direct sun during the day

solar.intro: See where the sun rises and sets, and whether the {{target}} gets afternoon sun.
solar.awayFromSun: {{side}} · not facing the sun right now
solar.needCoordinates: Enter the latitude and longitude (or press “Use my location”) to calculate.
solar.note: The sun's direction is calculated from true north; in Vietnam it differs from magnetic north by less than 1°. Shadows from neighboring buildings aren't taken into account.

age.title: Readings by the homeowner's age
age.intro: Optional. Turn it on to show the ring of favorable / unfavorable stars for a person's age on the compass and see whether the house direction suits them according to {{method}}.
age.name: Name
age.yearNote: The year starts at Tết (lunar new year).
age.yearNoteLunar: The year starts at Tết (lunar new year) — if born before Tết, use the previous year.
age.beforeTet: Born before Tết, so the age is counted for the year {{year}} ({{canChi}}).
age.houseSame: By sitting direction: a house sitting in {{segment}} is a {{trigram}} house ({{houseGroup}} group), the same group as {{personGroup}}.
age.houseOther: By sitting direction: a house sitting in {{segment}} is a {{trigram}} house ({{houseGroup}} group), a different group from {{personGroup}}.
age.lockFirst: Lock the {{target}} reading to see whether it's favorable or unfavorable.
age.drivesDial: The star ring on the compass is calculated for {{name}}.
